title: Strict étale restriction of coherent logarithmic image ideals
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes, $M$ a fine log structure on $X$, $\mathcal I\subset M$ a nonempty fine coherent log ideal [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, def-trf-fine-log-etale-descent-datum], and $K$ ideal sheaf data algebraizing its structural image [def-trf-log-ideal-algebraization-data]. Let $N$ be a log structure on $Y$ and $f:(Y,N)\to(X,M)$ a strict etale log map [def-trf-log-ideal-chart-presentation]. Then $N$ is fine, $\mathcal I_Y=f^{-1}(\mathcal I)N$ is nonempty fine coherent, and the extended ideal $K\mathcal O_Y$ algebraizes its structural image. For every etale $V\to Y$, the structural image-ideal sections of $\mathcal I_Y$ on $V$ equal those of $\mathcal I$ on the composite etale object $V\to Y\to X$, as subsets of the same regular-function ring. No finite-type, uniqueness, affine chart, transition or tensor-isomorphism conclusion on $Y$ is included here.

proof.text: Strictness identifies monoid sections on the source étale site with sections on the target slice, compatibly with alpha. Pull back the fine charts and their finite nonempty generators. These still generate the pulled-back log ideal stalkwise, proving fineness and nonempty fine coherence.

proof.text: On a pulled-back chart the same finite E generates the pulled-back ideal. Multiplicativity of alpha shows that its structural image is generated by the pulled-back alpha(e), and the reverse containment holds because these generators are in the pulled-back log ideal. Geometric-stalk membership on the slice therefore identifies the image ideals as the same subsets of regular functions on every étale source object, including nonaffine ones.

lean.statement:
theorem logIdeal_image_strict_etale {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (M : EtaleLogStructure X)
    (hM : M.IsFine) (I : M.IdealFamily) (hI : M.IsNonemptyFineCoherentIdeal I)
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) (hK : M.IsImageIdealAlgebraization I K)
    (N : EtaleLogStructure Y) (f : EtaleLogMap N M) (hf : f.IsStrictEtale) :
    N.IsFine ∧ N.IsNonemptyFineCoherentIdeal (f.pullbackIdeal I) ∧
      N.IsImageIdealAlgebraization (f.pullbackIdeal I) (K.comap f.base) ∧
      ∀ (he : Etale f.base) (V : Y.Etale),
        N.imageIdealSections (f.pullbackIdeal I) V =
          M.imageIdealSections I
            (@Scheme.Etale.mk X V.left (V.hom ≫ f.base) (by
              have := he
              infer_instance))
